title: Attendance Types — Create / Edit
overviewHtml: A kind of attendance away from the normal routine — business trip, training, on-site duty — recorded as employee attendance. It decides whether those days count as paid time, whether they fall on weekends and holidays, and whether they earn leave.

fields.label: Code
fields.rules: Optional. Left blank, the next number is assigned when the record is saved. Must be unique in this list.
fields.html:
What it is. A short code that identifies this item in its list.

Example. 001

fields.label: NameEn
fields.rules: Required. Must be unique in this list.
fields.html: What it is. The item's name in English.

fields.label: NameAr
fields.rules: Required. Must be unique in this list.
fields.html: What it is. The item's name in Arabic.

fields.label: WageType
fields.html:
What it is. The wagetype attendance of this type is paid under.

Example. Business Trip Allowance

Why it matters. An employee with attendance of this type in the pay period has this wagetype calculated as attendance pay.

fields.label: AccrualPeriod
fields.rules: Required. One of: No Accrual, Calendar Year, Fiscal Year, Work Year, Bi-Annual, Per Employment, Custom.
fields.html:
What it is. An accrual period for the attendance type.

Why it matters. Not read at present.

fields.label: LinkLeaveQuota
fields.rules: Optional. Chosen from Leave Type master data.
fields.html:
What it is. The leave that days of this attendance add to.

Example. Compensatory Leave

Why it matters. For that leave type, the balance is the attendance days recorded on types linked to it, less what has been taken.

fields.label: IncludePublicHoliday
fields.html:
What it is. Whether attendance on a public holiday counts.

Why it matters. Ticked, the day counts as attendance and is no longer treated as a holiday in the time register. Unticked, attendance of this type on a public holiday adds no time.

fields.label: HaveQuotaAccrual
fields.html:
What it is. Whether this attendance earns leave.

Why it matters. Ticked, Link Leave Quota must be filled in. The leave is earned through the link itself: any attendance type with a linked leave adds to it.
